predictions.rationale: This is the core domain model for orders, directly representing and implementing the order process, including creation, status tracking, payment, shipment, and cancellation.
Handles the creation of orders at checkout, which is a primary step in the order process described in the feature.
Handles the cancellation of orders, directly supporting the cancellation aspect of the order process.
Handles updating the order status to 'Stock Confirmed', which is a key step in the order lifecycle.
Handles updating the order status to 'Paid', directly supporting payment tracking in the order process.
Handles the shipment of orders, which is a critical part of the order process after payment and stock confirmation.
Defines the various statuses an order can have, supporting the tracking of order state throughout its lifecycle.
Represents the event when an order's status changes to 'Stock Confirmed', supporting integration and status tracking.
Represents the event when an order's status changes to 'Paid', supporting payment tracking and integration.
Represents the event when an order is cancelled, supporting the cancellation and notification aspects of the order process.
